page.overview:
Who is Artenn Gitelle?

Artenn Gitelle was the human leader of the Relic Seekers guild in Stilben, Tal'Dorei. In an adventure hook in the original Tal'Dorei Campaign Setting, set in 812 PD, a sect of the Remnants has been infiltrating the guilds of Stilben, and Artenn's corpse is discovered buried in the K'Tawl Swamp. Despite this, an entity previously thought to be Gitelle is still alive and well.

So far, Artenn has neither appeared nor been mentioned onstream.
